author: Codex: complete evidence reassessment, with distinct same-agent review
changeNote: Full 240-question reassessment requested by the owner. Rebuilt answers against literal current questions after fresh research; no left-ideology target, neighbour copying, score editing or matching-rule change. Corrects unsupported extrapolations and response strength, and distinguishes ownership, regulation and transfers. Preserves revisions 1–5, image and separate religious identity evidence.

metadata.name: Kamala Harris
metadata.description: Former US vice president advocating a regulated private-enterprise economy, progressive taxes and family support, reproductive and LGBTQ rights, border enforcement and military alliances.
metadata.period: 2017–4 October 2026; 2024 platform and 2026 statements weighted most heavily
metadata.scope: Personal positions and conduct, 2017–4 October 2026, with the 2024 presidential programme and September 2026 remarks weighted most heavily. Earlier views are counter-evidence when changed. Research performed 6 October 2026; retained period unchanged. Party and administration policies are contextual evidence, not automatically personal commitments. Hypothetical institutions and causal beliefs without explicit statements are educated assumptions. This is an interpreted questionnaire, not a survey completed by Harris or an empirical classification.
metadata.role: Former Vice President of the United States; national political campaigner

review.notes: Separate pass reviewed all 240 literal statements, directions, intensity, educated assumptions, contradictions and metadata. All answers conservatively inferred; none are attributed as a submitted questionnaire. Reconsidered direct-national-vote mechanisms without treating absence as automatic opposition; rejected occupational inference for suspicionless searches; distinguished cultural inclusion from increased migration, cooperation from international sovereignty, publicly funded services from state ownership, tax credits from low redistribution, and inclusive rights from trait heritability. Checked changed 2024 healthcare/fracking positions, constitutional limits, targeted protection, market activity and safety regulation as counter-evidence. Neutral choices represent specified competing commitments. The preferred left match in the request was excluded from assessment criteria. Sources read in this pass are listed; failed initial Roll Call, TIME platform, AP and PDF URLs were not credited as fresh evidence. The successfully opened campaign PDF uses the www host and underscore filename. The campaign policy book is identified as September 2024, with date recorded undated because an exact release day was not verified. Ifri is later contextual analysis of the retained 2024 programme. All inferred IDs are separately listed in evidence-review.json. Portrait retained after Commons verification; religion supplement unchanged. Similarity reviewed after freezing the answer set. Review corrected fourteen excessively noncommittal answers: seven legal-migration/family/graduate/support mechanisms and seven ownership/provision mechanisms now use the most likely qualified agreement or disagreement rather than treating lack of an exact proposal as Neutral. Remaining neutrality is explicitly competing commitments, not uncertainty alone. Validation reports no errors and three neutral-count warnings: authority-liberty 5/16, protectionism-free-trade 8/16, culture-nature 7/16. Reviewed each against explicit competing commitments in its rationale; retained without automatic substitution. Closest diagnostic personality Hillary Clinton r4 is 92.7%, below 95%; no close-pair retention entry is required.
